messages:
sara: Quick sync — customers keep asking for per-route billing fields + explicit token accounting for function/tool calls. Need to decide API shape and launch criteria. Anyone free for a quick thread?

devin: Can you paste a concrete example of what customers expect?

sara: Example payload customers sketched:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "route": "/customer-chat",
  "model": "redwood-chat-1",
  "messages": [...],
  "billing": { "unit": "tokens", "route_tag": "customer-chat" }
}
```
They want the API to return per-call usage breakdown so they can map to their internal cost centers.

liam: We should support per-route token accounting + per-function-call overhead. Tool calls can be huge (tool_input + tool_output). Recommend we add explicit `tool_tokens` in usage.

anita: Also surface `est_tokens` in the streaming response headers/payload so clients can budget while streaming. If that complicates impl, final accounting at end-of-stream is fine.

josh_finance: From pricing POV we need a stable billing formula. Suggest:
`billed_tokens = input_tokens + output_tokens + tool_tokens + (function_calls * 10)`
(10 token flat surcharge per function call to account for orchestration). Thoughts?

devin: We can emit usage structure like: 
```
"usage": {
  "input_tokens": 120,
  "output_tokens": 300,
  "tool_tokens": 80,
  "function_calls": 2,
  "units_billed": 510
}
```
This keeps token accounting explicit and makes mapping to price simple.

sara: Launch criteria proposal (quick bullets):
- API schema stable for 2 weeks and documented
- Console shows per-route tags + default unit
- Billing pipeline consumes `units_billed` w/ audit logs
- E2E tests for streaming + function call accounting
- Backwards compat: default to legacy total_token field if client doesn't opt-in

ops-bot: Created PD-4187 in product board: https://links.redwood/pd/PD-4187 — "per-route billing fields + token accounting"

anita: Edge cases: fallbacks to alternate model (routing) must annotate which model generated which tokens. Also partial failures: if function errors mid-call, we still need to attribute tool_tokens consumed.

liam: Implementation notes: gateway will increment per-route counters (tokens, requests) and attach route_tag to meter events. Quotas: propose three limit types per-route: `tokens_per_minute`, `requests_per_minute`, `concurrent_streams`. Bursting: allow short burst with token bucket and a soft warning metric.

josh_finance: For pricing alignment we need route-tier mapping (e.g., standard/premium) that affects per-token price. Also need UI to set default billing unit (tokens vs calls) and exportable audit CSV for invoices.

sara: Action items: @devin prototype response schema + example client, @liam infra quota design + perf impact estimate, @anita console mockups for route tags and billing defaults, @josh_finance confirm surcharge numbers and tier mapping. Goal: beta in ~6 weeks. :thumbsup:

liam: ack — will draft infra RFC and include traffic/latency implications for realtime streaming.

devin: will drop a quick PR with schema examples and a small shim for backwards compatibility.

josh_finance: will run scenarios on historical usage to recommend surcharge and tiers by EOD Friday.

sara: thanks all — I'll add acceptance criteria to PD-4187 and book a follow-up if needed.
